svg.title: A contract roll: unadjusted and back-adjusted series
svg.desc: Line chart with 36 points from 0 to 35 and 2 series (Unadjusted, Back-adjusted). 2 stacked panes on one time axis: Unadjusted, Back-adjusted. Unadjusted: opened at 67.00 on 0 and closed at 66.38 on 35, a change of −0.62 (−0.9%); high 69.16 on 12, low 65.10 on 20. Back-adjusted: opened at 64.00 on 0 and closed at 66.38 on 35, a change of +2.38 (+3.7%); high 67.82 on 33, low 63.42 on 0. Reference lines: Roll at 20; Roll at 20.
svg.text: A contract roll: unadjusted and back-adjusted series
